quest.title: A Saurian Returns to the Nest
quest.description: "Dad, if you've touched the stars, would you still want to return to the ground?"\n"Every creature that flies is born on the ground or in a nest, and they must all return whence they came."
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.text: Nice view, don't you think? Perfect for flying too. Soaring through the skies, following the wind... It's an awesome feeling all around.

response.text: Ho there, warrior! If it's a trial flight you're after, feel free.
My father built this place for me, but I don't mind sharing it.

choices.text: Thanks, I was just thinking about giving it a try.

response.text: You're welcome! Anyone who loves flying is a friend of Manyoya's! That's me, by the way.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: You look a little young for the Saurian flying squad. Are you a reserve rider? Or are you training to become a warrior?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We're just passing adventurers.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Oh? I rarely see adventurers so passionate about flight. Until a moment ago, I thought you were training for the flying squad exam.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Soaring through the skies... Now that's a feeling you never forget.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Doubt you'll find a soul who wouldn't hold onto that freedom no matter what, and I'm no exception.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You sound like you're in the know. Are you from the flying squad?

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Haha! I used to be! I'm retired now.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: I flew for quite some years — and while that doesn't make me too old by most measures, I was a real veteran in the flying squad.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: So when my physical condition fell off from where it used to be, it was time to say goodbye.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: No need to pity me. Haha! I'm not even sad, though it is quite regrettable.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Our young Saurian riders have just started taking to the air, but I've already caught a shooting star.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Things won't be the same anymore, of course, and I won't get to spend most of my day in the sky, I still have a chance to soar up there.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: So, that's why I'm here, reminiscing about the life I've given up.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Shame that flying solo is quite boring without the company of my squadmates.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Oh, yeah, how'd you like to fly with me? Our squad often had little competitions, just for fun.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: The one with the highest score would get tossed into the air while the lowest would pay for our meal.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You Saurian riders are a tight-knit bunch, huh?

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Yeah, everyone's amazing. We're both squadmates and rivals.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Ah, not that I'll ever get to enjoy that atmosphere again... Nor can I deny that my skills are on an inexorable downhill slide...

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: But even should physical strength decline and judgment dull, experience never stops stacking up.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: So I might have retired, but that's just from the squad — not from the skies.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: So, shall we compete? Think you can catch a veteran Saurian rider in the air?

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Huh. I was worried for a moment that you'd think me a freak for abruptly mentioning these things to a youngster like you. Thank goodness you didn't.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: But let me know when you want to give it a whirl. Let's set this as our objective:

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Ride your Saurian as far as you can along the designated course within the time limit. I'll help you keep score. The results are divided into 4 grades, and we'll count this as your win if you can beat the second-highest tier.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Let me know when you're ready to challenge me.

choices.text: Thanks. I'll think about it when I'm free.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: Not that easy, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: Our captain would be furious if word got out that we flying squad members could be surpassed by just any passing adventurer. Haha!

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: Alright, it's nothing to be upset about. I should be thanking you for keeping my pride intact, if anything.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: You flew quite well, but it's still too soon for you to surpass me.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: If you think you can do better, why don't you give it another try? You should never stop trying while you're young. Losing isn't a big deal anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: So, are we competing, then?

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: Ride your Saurian, and fly at full speed along the course, striving to get the highest possible score within the time limit. <color=#00E1FFFF>It counts as a win for you as long as you exceed the second-highest score tier.</color>

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Nice! Let's head to the starting point.

choices.text: I need a little more time.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Of course. Just let me know when you're ready. Flying has always been about relaxing and having fun.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: I enjoyed flying with you! Let's do this again sometime —but until then, take care, young adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: Hahaha! You were great! Guess it's true what they say, that the young are bound to surpass the old.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: Even stars may fall, let alone people.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: My time is over. Retiring happily was the right choice.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: ... Ah, but it's just so difficult to accept. I'm still young, I don't even have wrinkles. Why do I even have to retire?

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: How could my career be over so soon? I started falling before I could even experience what it was like to reach the top.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: Had I known I'd have so many regrets...

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: Never mind. If I could do it all again, I would still make the same choices.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: I would still do my best to join the flying squad, which isn't difficult given my skills. Then I'd wind up retiring at this age again.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: I've done my best, and all I can do now is accept it.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: I guess that's life. Many things are beyond our control, and if you dream of being a hero, perhaps you must accept that you can shine for but an instant.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Manyoya...

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: #Not to worry, {M#he}{F#she}'s a brilliant flier. You had this pitying look the whole time, so why the uneasy face now?

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: Haha! Life's full of surprises, and they'll come whether you accept 'em or not.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: Consider it a pearl of wisdom from a retired Saurian rider. My issues are my own to solve. Don't let them ruin your mood.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: I'm impressed. If only my siblings were as calm as you are.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You have siblings?

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: That's right. Two younger brothers, and unlike you, they're a chore and a half to get through to.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: They're training their flying skills too— Well, no. Acomitl's just focused on running away from it all, so he might've been hiding instead.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: Forget about those brats. I can see your talent, clear as day.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: Try training a little more if you get the time. Who knows? The flying squad may come knocking at your door.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll try my best.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: That's good to hear. I hope I'll catch you flying again. Good luck, young warrior.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: It's time for my Saurian to return to its nest. Shall I too descend from the stage in the skies?

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: I guess you heard me mumbling to myself, huh?

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: I should make a trip home — haven't told my family about my retirement yet.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: I'll have a bunch of free time soon, but I haven't figured out what to do with it.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Once I find my bearings, I'll have to face the next stage of my life.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: So I should hear what my family has to say about it first. My father used to be in the flying squad, and he became a training master after retirement.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: He's been on this path, so he's got to have some thoughts on the matter.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: So, I'll be dismantling this place and taking it with me, but I'll leave the course here. Young warriors like you still need a place to train, after all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Will we meet again, Manyoya?

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: I don't know. But no matter what choice I make, I don't think I can ever give up on the skies.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: So as long as you don't stop flying, I think we'll meet again.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Until next time, then.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: See you, young warrior.

response.speaker: Manyoya
response.text: Oh, there you are.

dialogues.speaker: Manyoya
dialogues.text: Ride your Saurian, and fly at full speed along the course, striving to get the highest possible score within the time limit. <color=#00E1FFFF>It counts as a win for you as long as you exceed the second-highest score tier.</color>
"Sing me a song, call the flying Saurians and birds who have left their nests..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Do you hear that? Someone way up high is singing, and they're pretty good too. Wanna go say hello to them?
